description.value: Mongo Bongo is a Mongolian grill in New Westminster where diners build their own stir-fry bowl by selecting proteins, noodles, fresh vegetables, and sauces before watching chefs cook it on a large grill. The interactive concept — taglined 'a self-inspired creation' — makes it a filling, customizable stop with both lunch and dinner seatings. A full bar including beer, wine, and signature martinis rounds out the menu for cyclists looking for a proper sit-down meal.
